entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'or' between a float-valued and a histogram-valued operand is not supported; 'and'/'unless' support mixing them
entries.rationale: lowerVectorSetOp reaches this branch only when NEITHER of its own LHS/RHS operands was recognised as a Mixed shape by lowerVectorSetOpOperand (leftMixed/rightMixed both false) AND the OUTER BinaryExpr b itself was handed to lowerBinary/lowerVectorSetOp by a caller that never checked mixedExpHistogramSetOp(b, s, ctx) on b first — because mixedExpHistogramSetOp recognises exactly this shape (an `or` BinaryExpr whose two sides disagree on histogram-valuedness) regardless of where in the tree b sits, so any caller that pre-checks it before falling back to a bare lower() call would already have routed b through lowerMixedExpHistogramSetOp instead of ever reaching lowerBinary with it. Before cerberus issue #2613, absent()'s general argument branch, limitk()/limit_ratio()'s aggregate-argument branch (lowerLimitKInput), and unary `+`/`-` (lowerUnary) were the last three remaining callers that could hand lowerBinary a raw, unrecognised top-level `or` BinaryExpr this way — each called bare lower() (or, for limitk/limit_ratio, the histogram-only lowerExpHistogramValuedShape check alone) on their vector argument without first checking mixedExpHistogramSetOp on it. #2613 rewired all three through lowerVectorSetOpOperand (absent()) or an equivalent mixedExpHistogramSetOp check (lowerLimitKInput, lowerUnary), closing the last gaps: every remaining path that can reach lower() with a vector-typed expression either already excluded a mixed `or` shape upstream (see lower.go:lower#d33d0084's own rationale) or is now one of those three rewired callers. lowerRoot's own top-level dispatch (lowerHistogramNativeRoot) already covered every wrapper function reachable as the query root or a bare top-level subquery's inner expression (cerberus issue #2543) before #2613, so between that existing coverage and #2613's three closures, no wire-level PromQL query reaches this branch through this promql package's own current lowering surface any more.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators")
